title: Project Manager Agent - Directory Contract
description: Runtime directory contract. Business paths are resolved through common.workspace_config instead of legacy Desktop defaults.

project_files.description: Business project data root resolved from WorkspaceConfig.business_root. Runtime workspace must not own real archived project files.

data_cleaning_workbench.description: Data cleaning workbench for run packages and structured outputs. Source files are read from WorkspaceConfig.business_root by default.

agent_state.description: Agent runtime state under the configured runtime workspace.

agent_logs.description: Agent traces under the configured runtime workspace.

validation_rules.fix: Set PROJECT_MANAGER_BUSINESS_ROOT or PROJECT_MANAGER_WORKSPACE_DIR when defaults do not match this machine.

validation_rules.check: cloud-drive files must be readable before extraction or archive execution
validation_rules.fix: Let the sync client hydrate files, then rerun the loop.
